scope: 4D's Quick Report editor (QR REPORT with the editor), published by the native plugin alone from its form's layers: the toolbar, its Destination and Options panels, the report's columns read-only, the record count, and the Fields sheet whose available fields are added by pressing and whose columns are selected and removed; a columnar report built through accessibility and executed to HTML through macOS's Save dialog; by AX and by VoiceOver
fixture: prepare_quick_report_fixture.py and test_quick_report_fixture.py (Orders table with five records)
checks: the Quick Report editor is pixel-identical to the plugin-free editor
the toolbar's buttons are published by their titles
the record count is published, and a new report has no columns
the Fields sheet publishes the available fields and the buttons that move them
pressing an available field adds it to the report's columns
a column pressed, then Remove column, leaves the report
OK returns to the editor, which publishes the report's columns
the destinations are radio buttons, Print chosen
Execute writes the report the columns describe, with every record
VoiceOver reaches the Quick Report editor
VO-Space on a field adds it to the report's columns
OK makes the chosen field the report's column
VoiceOver reads the destinations as radio buttons, Print selected

regressions.test_query_editor_fixture.py: 14 checks, and 13 with VoiceOver, on the shared list items; one VoiceOver run heard no speech at all and two reruns passed

notCovered: The report's cells, header and footer
Reporting which column is selected in the Fields sheet
Executing to a file or the printer
